title: Two open projects with the same folder name share one main session name
notes: mainSessionName (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts) is main- plus the slug of the folder's basename, so ~/work/api and ~/clients/api both run their main as main-api. With both open, a worker's or manager's SendMessage to main-api can land in the wrong project's main. Derive the name from something unique per open project. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/230 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/229#discussion_r4501925947
